plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Global Asia Studies, BA, plan LAASIABA, campus ASU00). Term-by-term sequence as published. Credit ranges transcribed at the lower bound per convention; 'X or Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the course code with choice=true. Gen-ed placeholders (no course code on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. The official major map lists the following course(s) in more than one term: Across Asia Course, Complete 2 courses: Upper Division Global Asia Track Elective, ENG 101 or ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 or ENG 108: First-Year Composition, Elective, Global Asia Track Elective, Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD), Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT), Second Language: Requirement satisfied through the following: * Completion of Arabic, Chinese, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai or Vietnamese language course at the intermediate level (202 or equivalent). Students who are already proficient in one of these languages, or another language relevant to the study of Asia, such as Dutch, Tagalog or Urdu, may take a proficiency exam., Term hours subtotal:; allow_repeated_courses is set per the genuine-repeat rule. All other fields (codes, titles, credits, order, choice flags, repeats) unchanged from the official ASU major map transcription.
